info.meaning: Your browser tells every site its name, version and system, as shown above. That's normal, and on its own it doesn't single you out; combined with screen size and fonts, it can.
info.pro: Agent Cloaking in Incognito Browser changes the browser and device sites are told about. Incognito Pro also blocks trackers.

amber.meaning: Your browser announces an old version, as flagged above. Old versions are rarer, so they stand out more, and they also miss security fixes. Update it before anything else.
amber.pro: Update first. Then Agent Cloaking in Incognito Browser changes the browser and device sites are told about, and Incognito Pro blocks trackers on top.
